item.title: Burger Memes Go Viral On X, Bringing '#Burgertwt' To The Mainstream
item.description: Burger Twitter or Burgertwt, also known as Burger Posting is a series of X / Twitter posts making absurd jokes about burgers, sometimes using the hashtag "#burgertwt." The hashtag has been used informally on X since as early as January 2021 in posts relating to burgers. It was popularized as the subject of memes in late January and early February 2026, inspiring numerous viral posts using the word "burger" as a punchline to often nonsensical jokes and pieces of art featuring burgers.
